profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced in algorithm development for audio pipeline -- echo cancellation, noise suppression, beamforming, gain controllers, equalizers, compressors and machine learning for audio pattern recognition such as baby cry, car alarms etc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I work in a team of audio R&D engineers responsible for keeping the competitive edge of Microsoft’s real-time audio on Teams -- with particular focus on audio DSP acoustic echo cancellation and noise suppression.

positions.title: Embedded DSP R & D Software Engineer
positions.description:
Research and development of optimal algorithms for 
1. Acoustic beamforming using different microphone array topologies for RTOS
2. Estimation of DoA of speech signals
3. Efficient noise suppression for RTOS
4. Efficient AEC for RTOS

Sample projects I worked on:
[10] Acoustic source localization using circular array microphones  https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/acoustic-source-localization-using-circular-array-microphones/
[9] Maximum likelihood voice activity detector https://www.vocal.com/voice-quality-enhancement/maximum-likelihood-voice-activity-detector/
[8] Half plane least squares acoustic source localization using uniform linear array
https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/half-plane-least-squares-acoustic-sound-source-localization/
[7] Exact, elegant coherence based sub-band angle of arrival estimation for broadband acoustic signals https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/exact-elegant-coherence-based-sub-band-angle-of-arrival-estimation-for-broadband-acoustic-signals/
[6] Eigen space based voice activity detector for multiple microphone array broadband acoustics https://www.vocal.com/voice-quality-enhancement/eigen-space-voice-activity-detector-for-multiple-microphone-array-broadband-acoustics/
[5] Root-MUSIC based sub-band angle of arrival estimation for broadband acoustics https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/root-music-sub-band-aoa-estimation/
[4] Non-aliased time difference angle of arrival estimation https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/non-aliased-tdoa-angle-of-arrival-estimation/
[3] Fast, efficient and finite search grid SRP-PHAT angle of arrival estimation for acoustic array beamforming  https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/finite-set-srp-phat-aoa-estimation-for-beamforming/
[2] Fundamental limits on angle of arrival estimation error for acoustic microphone array https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/aoa-fundamental-limits/
[1] Fast, efficient GCC for online speech angle of arrival detection https://www.vocal.com/beamforming/gcc-for-speech-aoa-detection/

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
I was part of the team of Engineers who were in charge of all Electricity Network design, upgrade and load analysis for the entire country. I was in charge of running load flow analysis of the high voltage 33kV network and recommend upgrades, new constructions and retiring of network portions.
I was also actively involved in appraising designs submitted from the various regions for LV/HV injections or upgrades.

positions.title: Intelligent Networks Engineer
positions.description: I was the second leg of a two man Intelligent Network Engineers team who were in charge of monitory ,maintaining and upgrading the Intelligent Network for Huawei customer, Tigo Ghana. The Intelligent Network included the subscriber database, customer billing and network call traffic routing.

projects.title: Spring heuristic approach to display connected networks
projects.description: Developed an algorithm using the so called spring heuristic to graphical display a connected network by minimizing the total energy of the system.

projects.title: Walkie-talkie implementation using the USRP
projects.description: Implemented a walkie-talkie with the USRP using AM and NBFM modulation schemes.
